# Draft Counterclaims / Crossclaims / Third-Party Claims

## Inputs
1) Type: counterclaim / crossclaim / third-party claim
2) Parties (existing + new), capacities, and relationships
3) Forum (optional)
4) Claims to assert + remedies sought
5) Core facts and documents
6) How this integrates with the answer/complaint (what allegations you want incorporated)

## Outputs
1) Draft pleading
2) Element coverage table (or placeholders)
3) Dependency checklist:
   - required parties
   - required allegations (notice, contract terms, agency)
   - exhibits/documents to reference
   - timing constraints (if any; as placeholders)

## Rules
- Do not assume impleader/joinder requirements; treat as jurisdiction-dependent and flag:
  - `[CHECK PROCEDURAL REQUIREMENTS: third-party practice/joinder]`
- Keep facts consistent with the answer positions (no contradictory allegations without explicit strategy note).

## QC
- Party alignment: who did what to whom
- Remedy alignment: damages theory matches facts
- Integration: no contradictions with the answer
